judge.rationale: The candidate correctly removes the `error instanceof Error` gate in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` and wraps non-Error rejections in an `Error` with `{cause: error}`, rethrowing the original value unchanged. It satisfies every acceptance criterion, including testing string, plain object, and `undefined` rejections, updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` (plus line-number links in related specs), and documenting the change in `CHANGELOG.md`. The implementation in `chatOrchestrator.ts` (`describeRejection` and `serializedOrNull`) and the parameterized unit test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are nearly identical to the reference. The only slight divergence from the reference is the leftover `.lore/dod.md` file and an extra standalone acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts`).
